name: A Vignette of Life on the Frontier
material: Folding fan; ink and color on paper
dimensions: Painting: 19 x 55 cm (7 1/2 x 21 5/8 in.); Overall with sticks: 33 x 55 cm (13 x 21 5/8 in.)
summary: Jiao Bingzhen, a court painter largely active during the reign of the Kangxi Emperor, was the senior artist on this fan.
